environment_variables.name: FOCR_MODEL_PATH
environment_variables.summary: override the model artifact path (a .focrq blob or safetensors directory)

environment_variables.name: FOCR_MODEL_DIR
environment_variables.summary: extra model search roots before the default cache

environment_variables.name: FOCR_QUANT
environment_variables.summary: pick the quant-suffixed artifact during cache resolution

environment_variables.name: FOCR_MAX_NEW_TOKENS
environment_variables.summary: cap generated tokens (an explicit --max-length outranks it)

environment_variables.name: FOCR_STAGE_BUDGET_FORWARD_MS
environment_variables.summary: forward stage budget in ms (default 600000; 0 or `unlimited` disables the timeout)

environment_variables.name: FOCR_TIMING
environment_variables.summary: emit nested stage-timing rows on stderr (disables the resident daemon and progress bar)

environment_variables.name: FOCR_NO_PROGRESS
environment_variables.summary: disable the interactive stderr progress bar

environment_variables.name: FOCR_MMAP
environment_variables.summary: opt trusted immutable artifacts into read-only mmap

environment_variables.name: FOCR_NO_RESIDENT
environment_variables.summary: 1/true disables the resident warm-model daemon (flag analog: --no-resident)

environment_variables.name: FOCR_RESIDENT_DIR
environment_variables.summary: override the resident daemon state-file directory

environment_variables.name: FOCR_RESIDENT_LOG
environment_variables.summary: append resident daemon diagnostics to this file

environment_variables.name: FOCR_RESIDENT_SPAWN_WAIT_SECS
environment_variables.summary: how long a client waits for a freshly spawned daemon to accept (default 30)

environment_variables.name: FOCR_RESIDENT_CLIENT_TIMEOUT_SECS
environment_variables.summary: client-side reply timeout for a resident request (default 600)

environment_variables.name: FOCR_TEST_MAX_POSITIONS
environment_variables.summary: TEST-ONLY: lower the position budget prompt and output share (1..=32768; a larger value exits 2) so tests reach the multi-page clamp on small documents

exit_codes.meaning: model artifact was not found or could not be resolved
exit_codes.name: model_not_found

exit_codes.meaning: input image or page could not be decoded
exit_codes.name: input_decode

exit_codes.meaning: run completed but a large input yielded almost no text and --fail-on-low-yield was set
exit_codes.name: low_yield

status: live — run_start/run_complete (carries `markdown` and `finish_reason`, plus `warnings` when a decode reported any)/run_error plus the streaming page, staff, and music_warning events are wired and contract-tested against `event_fields`; `run_error` carries `recovery`
stdout_contract: robot mode emits one JSON object per line on stdout and NOTHING else there; diagnostics go to stderr
